svg.title: CloudBSD Admin — vGPU Pool (list view, sidecar open on gpu-2)
svg.desc: GPU pool presented as a list (12 GPUs, click any row to open sidecar). 12 physical GPUs across 3 nodes: 5x T4, 4x A4000, 2x A5000, 1x A6000, 1x A100-MIG. Sidecar pattern: gpu-2 (A4000) selected, Overview tab active showing identity, hardware, allocations, quick actions. Threshold rule: count > 10 forces list view, panel toggle hidden (T94k).

div.div: 12 physical GPUs · 3 nodes · 304 GB total VRAM · 22 vGPU allocations
